## Close Screen

---


[__Entity Action Type__](https://eggolib.github.io/latest/types/entity_action_types/close_screen)

Closes the current screen of the player.

Type ID: `eggolib:close_screen`

---

### Examples

``` json
"entity_action": {
    "type": "eggolib:close_screen"
}
```
